set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- The project declares explicit pre-1.0 and post-1.0 compatibility policies.
- An exact Intaglio Git baseline is checked automatically with JVM binary/source-forward MiMa and Scala 3 TASTy compatibility courts.
- The public API is inventoried before the baseline freeze: intentional compatibility aliases are documented and tested, and accidental extraction types or aliases are absent.
